result.instructions: Verified-Bar Sokoban & PuzzleScript MCP server implementing the Proven-Commons methodology (declarative specification oracle separated from zero-allocation C++20 search, 10-mutation planted-bug auditing, chiral-mirror & iterative tube-beam optimization, sliding-window exact BFS, and runtime step-consistency audited IDA* lower-bound proving). Always verify or optimize routes through these tools so every reported sequence carries a dual-oracle VERIFIED certificate.

tools.name: soko_capabilities
tools.description: Report available backends and missing implementations in this checkout.

tools.name: soko_list_rooms
tools.title: List Built-In Frontier Benchmark Rooms
tools.description: List built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier rooms, proven floors, shortest-known targets, live records, and verified reference routes.

tools.name: soko_inspect_room
tools.title: Inspect Room Symmetries, Chirality & Bottlenecks
tools.description: Analyze a built-in room_id or custom (part, grid) for X/Y/180-degree dungeon symmetries, hero-switch chirality opportunities, switch-weighing deficits, and Bard rigid-translation constraints.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

tools.name: soko_verify_route
tools.title: Dual-Oracle Differential Route Verifier
tools.description: Replay a U/D/L/R/A move sequence through BOTH the declarative Python PuzzleScriptOracle and the C++20 engine, returning a cryptographic SHA-256 VERIFIED certificate and final ASCII board.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

route.description: Move string composed of U, D, L, R, and A (Action: switch active hero).

tools.name: soko_optimize_route
tools.title: Optimize Seed Route via Windowed BFS & Chiral-Mirror Tube Beam
tools.description: Shorten a valid seed route using Exact Sliding-Window BFS, Chiral-Mirror (X/Y/Rot180) Role-Agnostic Tube Beam Search, and Iterative Tube Refinement (the pipeline that broke III-20 from 87 -> 84 keys). Dual-verifies any improvement.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

seed_route.description: Valid U/D/L/R/A winning route to optimize (if omitted for a built-in room_id, uses the room's reference or prior record route).

beam_width.description: Beam width per depth layer for Chiral-Mirror and Iterative Tube Beam.

window_len.description: Sliding window length for exact BFS subpath shortcutting.

budget_sec.description: Total compute budget in seconds across optimization stages.

tools.name: soko_solve_room
tools.title: Solve Room From Scratch via Diversified Beam Search
tools.description: Search for a winning U/D/L/R/A move sequence from scratch without a seed route using bucket-diversified C++20 beam search plus exact window polishing and dual-oracle verification.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

tools.name: soko_prove_floor
tools.title: Certify Lower Bound via Step-Consistent IDA*
tools.description: Prove a machine-checked lower bound (floor >= B) using transposition-table IDA* with runtime step-consistency assertions (h(s) <= 1 + h(s')) checked on every expanded state transition.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

tools.name: soko_verify_tcb_lock
tools.title: Verify Runtime SHA256SUMS TCB Lock
tools.description: Verify confined SHA256SUMS manifest integrity for tracked checker sources/binaries and inspect SHA-256 TCB pins; fails closed on path escape or null pins.

tools.name: soko_run_planted_bug_audit
tools.title: Run 10-Mutation Proven-Commons Planted-Bug Audit
tools.description: Inject 10 realistic PuzzleScript physics bugs into the specification oracle (single-push collapse, rule-order swap, Bard Manhattan/post-move bugs, non-weighing walls, Wizard adjacent swap, inactive Priest heal, sequential Goblin kill, hero-cycle swap, missing Cancel) and verify 10/10 detection.

extra_vectors.description: Optional additional regression test vectors to include in the mutation audit.
